title: Stock (api)
description: The `data` block of a stock change event as delivered on the api channel (webhook / API destination): the Gold master projected onto attributes whose x-channels includes 'api'.

productId.description: Pearson product identifier (PPID) — joins stock rows to gold_product.product

isbn13.description: ISBN-13 of the stocked product — only true 13-digit ISBNs starting with 9; other source codes map to null

onHandQuantity.description: Total on-hand quantity for this product in this organization, rounded to the nearest whole unit

availableToPromiseIndicator.description: Available-to-promise flag (Y when any staging row in the group is ATP-eligible)
